additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417606-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R6 170002001] DC1 Connector CRM:02679000065
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked and found the following issues:
Follow the steps below:
1.Please check if the power converter are properly connection to its shelf case.
2. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
3. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
4. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter is faulty, we suggest you to replace it.
Attached KA for your reference:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 -
Kindly check the connections according to diagram below:
Check if the RCD FB3 or any of the breaker is tripped.
Check for any loose connections and all the wirings according to diagram.
2025-04-07T05:23:00.046796+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/57e00f9731dd[734]: Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1223051425 status: {"value":1,"bits":{"suLinkStatusIsOk":true,"muFatalErrorOccured":false,"transactionIsOnGoing":false,"tamperingIsDetected":false,
"timeSyncStatusIsOk":false
,"overTemperatureIsDetected":false,"reversedVoltage":false,"suMeasureFailureOccurred":false}}, error: {"value":0,"bits":{"muInitIsFailed":false,"suStateIsInvalid":false,"versionCheckIsFailed":false,"muRngInitIsFailed":false,"muDataIntegrityIsFailed":false,"muFwIntegrityIsFailed":false,"suIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIsFull":false,"memoryAccessIsFailed":false,"muStateIsFailed":false}})
This indicates- Time synchronization expired: last valid synchronization is older than 48 hours.
Solution-
1. In command synchronization mode, achieve a new synchronization
2. In NTP synchronization mode, check the settings, as well as network access to the NTP servers
Do let us know if you have any queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
